name: Aftab Akram
title: PhD Researcher
tagline: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning · Applied Cryptography · Federated Learning
about: I am a PhD researcher working on privacy-preserving machine learning and applied cryptography. My research focuses on designing trustworthy and privacy-preserving federated learning systems using cryptographic techniques.

My research interests include secure aggregation, homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, differential privacy, federated unlearning, machine unlearning, adversarial robustness, and blockchain-based approaches for trustworthy federated learning.
